# Bh
def bh(p):
 p=np.asarray(p,float);order=np.argsort(p);q=np.minimum.accumulate((p[order]*len(p)/np.arange(1,len(p)+1))[::-1])[::-1]
 out=np.empty_like(q);out[order]=np.minimum(q,1);return out

# Weights
def weights(xy,k):
 n=len(xy);dist,ids=cKDTree(xy).query(xy,k=min(k+1,n));ids=ids[:,1:];dist=dist[:,1:]
 w=sparse.csr_matrix((np.full(ids.size,1/ids.shape[1]),(np.repeat(np.arange(n),ids.shape[1]),ids.ravel())),shape=(n,n))
 return w,ids,dist

# Moran
def moran(z,w,permutations=999,seed=SEED):
 z=np.asarray(z,float)-np.mean(z);n=len(z);den=z@z;scale=n/w.sum()
 observed=float(scale*(z@(w@z))/den);rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);sim=[]
 for _ in range(permutations):
  q=rng.permutation(z);sim.append(float(scale*(q@(w@q))/den))
 sim=np.asarray(sim);expected=-1/(n-1)
 p=(1+np.count_nonzero(np.abs(sim-expected)>=abs(observed-expected)))/(permutations+1)
 return {'I':observed,'expected':expected,'p_two_sided':p,'permutations':permutations}

# Local moran
def local_moran(x,ids,y=None,permutations=999,seed=SEED):
 """Igual peso nos k vizinhos. Bivariado: X_i versus média de Y_j."""
 x=np.asarray(x,float);z=(x-x.mean())/x.std(ddof=1);n=len(z);k=ids.shape[1]
 zy=z if y is None else (np.asarray(y,float)-np.mean(y))/np.std(y,ddof=1)
 lag=zy[ids].mean(axis=1);stat=z*lag;rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);p=np.empty(n)
 for i in range(n):

  draws=rng.integers(0,n-1,size=(permutations,k))
  bad=np.any(np.diff(np.sort(draws,axis=1),axis=1)==0,axis=1)
  while bad.any():
   draws[bad]=rng.integers(0,n-1,size=(int(bad.sum()),k));bad=np.any(np.diff(np.sort(draws,axis=1),axis=1)==0,axis=1)
  draws+=draws>=i;sim=z[i]*zy[draws].mean(axis=1)
  expect=-z[i]*zy[i]/(n-1)
  p[i]=(1+np.count_nonzero(np.abs(sim-expect)>=abs(stat[i]-expect)))/(permutations+1)
 q=bh(p);quad=np.where(z>=0,np.where(lag>=0,'Alto–alto','Alto–baixo'),np.where(lag>=0,'Baixo–alto','Baixo–baixo'))
 return pd.DataFrame({'local_I':stat,'p_conditional':p,'q_FDR':q,'z':z,'spatial_lag':lag,'quadrant':quad,'cluster':np.where(q<=.05,quad,'Não significativo')})

# Silhouette
def silhouette(x,labels):
 d=distance.cdist(x,x);classes=np.unique(labels);s=[]
 for i,label in enumerate(labels):
  same=labels==label;n=same.sum()
  if n<=1:s.append(0.);continue
  a=d[i,same].sum()/(n-1);b=min(d[i,labels==c].mean() for c in classes if c!=label)
  s.append((b-a)/max(a,b) if max(a,b)>0 else 0.)
 return float(np.mean(s))

# Ari
def ari(a,b):
 a=np.unique(a,return_inverse=True)[1];b=np.unique(b,return_inverse=True)[1];t=np.zeros((a.max()+1,b.max()+1));np.add.at(t,(a,b),1)
 c=lambda v:np.sum(v*(v-1)/2)
 n=len(a);total=n*(n-1)/2;s=c(t);expected=c(t.sum(0))*c(t.sum(1))/total;mx=(c(t.sum(0))+c(t.sum(1)))/2
 return float((s-expected)/(mx-expected)) if mx>expected else 1.

# Relative quartile
def relative_quartile(v):
 q=np.quantile(v,[.25,.5,.75]);return np.searchsorted(q,np.asarray(v),side='left')+1,q

# Relative quintile
def relative_quintile(v):
 """Cinco faixas P20/P40/P60/P80; empates permanecem juntos."""
 q=np.quantile(v,[.2,.4,.6,.8]);return np.searchsorted(q,np.asarray(v),side='left')+1,q

# Cells for
def cells_for(points,municipality):
 parts=voronoi_polygons(MultiPoint(points.geometry.to_list()),extend_to=municipality.envelope,ordered=True)
 cells=gpd.GeoDataFrame({'receptor_id':points.receptor_id.to_numpy()},geometry=[v.intersection(municipality) for v in parts.geoms],crs=config.CRS_PROJECT)
 cells.geometry=make_valid(cells.geometry);assert len(cells)==len(points) and cells.area.gt(0).all()
 assert abs(cells.area.sum()-municipality.area)/municipality.area<1e-7
 return cells

# Emission allocation
def emission_allocation(cells,municipality,pol):
 sources=gpd.read_file(BASE/f'output/13_rateio_emissoes/fontes_rateio_{pol}.gpkg').to_crs(cells.crs)
 masses=np.zeros(len(cells));records=[];expected=0.;missing=0
 for r in sources.itertuples():
  geom=make_valid(r.geometry)
  if geom.is_empty or not np.isfinite(r.massa):missing+=1;continue
  mode='area' if geom.area>0 else 'length' if geom.length>0 else 'point'
  denominator=geom.area if mode=='area' else geom.length if mode=='length' else 1
  inside=geom.intersection(municipality)
  fraction=inside.area/denominator if mode=='area' else inside.length/denominator if mode=='length' else float(municipality.covers(geom))
  expected+=r.massa*fraction
  candidates=cells.sindex.query(geom,predicate='intersects')
  if mode=='point' and len(candidates)>1:
   candidates=np.array([min(candidates,key=lambda j:(cells.geometry.iloc[j].representative_point().distance(geom),j))])
  for j in candidates:
   it=geom.intersection(cells.geometry.iloc[j]);f=it.area/denominator if mode=='area' else it.length/denominator if mode=='length' else 1.
   if f<=0:continue
   mass=float(r.massa*f);masses[j]+=mass;records.append({'pollutant':pol,'source_id':r.source_id,'group_id':r.group_id,'source_type':r.source_type,'receptor_id':int(cells.receptor_id.iloc[j]),'fraction':f,'mass_tpy':mass})
 err=abs(masses.sum()-expected);assert err<=max(.001,expected*1e-7),(pol,err,expected)
 pd.DataFrame(records).to_csv(OUT/f'{pol}_fontes_celulas.csv',index=False)
 return masses,{'total_source_mass_tpy':float(sources.massa.sum()),'municipal_mass_expected_tpy':expected,'allocated_mass_tpy':float(masses.sum()),'absolute_error_tpy':err,'sources_missing_geometry_or_mass':missing,'volume_geometry':'Suporte geométrico do cadastro; não área física emissora comprovada.'}

# Stump
def stump(x,y,min_fraction=.1):
 order=np.argsort(x);sx=x[order];sy=y[order];n=len(x);a=np.cumsum(sy);b=np.cumsum(sy*sy);j=np.arange(1,n);minn=max(5,int(n*min_fraction))
 score=(b[:-1]-a[:-1]**2/j)+(b[-1]-b[:-1]-(a[-1]-a[:-1])**2/(n-j));ok=(j>=minn)&(j<=n-minn)&(sx[:-1]<sx[1:]);score[~ok]=np.inf
 if not np.isfinite(score).any():return None
 cut=np.argmin(score);return (float((sx[cut]+sx[cut+1])/2),float(sy[:cut+1].mean()),float(sy[cut+1:].mean()))

# Thresholds
def thresholds(x,y,xy,pol,unit):
 out=[];lx=np.log1p(x);ly=np.log1p(y);fit=stump(lx,ly)
 for size in [2000,4000]:
  blocks=np.floor((xy-xy.min(0))/size).astype(int);keys=[tuple(v) for v in blocks];unique=sorted(set(keys));rng=np.random.default_rng(SEED);rng.shuffle(unique);fold={b:i%5 for i,b in enumerate(unique)};folds=np.array([fold[k] for k in keys])
  for k in range(5):
   test=folds==k;train=~test
   if min(test.sum(),train.sum())<10:continue
   f=stump(lx[train],ly[train]);
   if f is None:continue
   pred=np.where(lx[test]<=f[0],f[1],f[2]);mse=np.mean((pred-ly[test])**2);null=np.mean((ly[train].mean()-ly[test])**2)
   out.append({'pollutant':pol,'emission_basis':unit,'block_m':size,'fold':k,'threshold':np.expm1(f[0]),'threshold_all_data':np.expm1(fit[0]) if fit else np.nan,'skill_vs_mean':1-mse/null if null>0 else np.nan,'rmse_log1p':np.sqrt(mse),'n_train':int(train.sum()),'n_test':int(test.sum()),'low_mean_conc':np.expm1(f[1]),'high_mean_conc':np.expm1(f[2])})
 return out

BREAKS=[0,.5,1,2,3,5,10]

# Histogram
def histogram():
    p=config.BASE/'output/16_revisao_pos_banca/vento/calendario_vento_horario.csv'
    c=pd.read_csv(p);v=c[c.direction_idx.ge(0)]
    assert len(v)==24892 and v.wind_speed.between(0,10).all()

    h=np.zeros((12,6),dtype=int);np.add.at(h,(directions,speed),1)
    assert h.sum()==len(v)
    return h,100*h/len(v)

def draw(ax,selected=None,fontsize=5.5):
    _,freq=histogram();ax.set_theta_zero_location('N');ax.set_theta_direction(-1)
    selected_idx=DIRS.index(selected) if selected in DIRS else None
    ax.set_facecolor('white');ax.set_ylim(0,np.ceil(freq.sum(axis=1).max()/5)*5)
    for i in range(12):
        lo=i*30-15;hi=i*30+15
        cuts=[lo,hi]
        if selected_idx is not None:
            for offset in [-360,0,360]:
                cuts.extend(x for x in [selected_idx*45-22.5+offset,selected_idx*45+22.5+offset] if lo<x<hi)
        cuts=sorted(set(cuts))
        for a,b in zip(cuts[:-1],cuts[1:]):
            active=selected_idx is None or abs((((a+b)/2-selected_idx*45+180)%360)-180)<=22.5
            bottom=0.
            for j,height in enumerate(freq[i]):
                ax.bar(np.deg2rad((a+b)/2),height,width=np.deg2rad(b-a)*.98,bottom=bottom,color=COLORS[j] if active else '#dce0df',edgecolor='white',linewidth=.18,zorder=3)
                bottom+=height
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(8)*np.pi/4,DIRS,fontsize=fontsize)

    maximum=ax.get_ylim()[1];ticks=np.arange(5,maximum,5)

    ax.set_rlabel_position(275);ax.grid(color='#d6dedc',linewidth=.3)
    ax.spines['polar'].set_color('#c6cecb');ax.spines['polar'].set_linewidth(.35)
    ax.tick_params(axis='x',pad=0)

funcoes.doc:
Percentil por posto (nearest-rank), sem interpolação.

Para n valores ordenados crescentemente, usa posição ceil(p*n), limitada a 1..n.
Essa forma é mais próxima do procedimento de seleção por posto usado em métricas
regulatórias do que a interpolação linear padrão de muitas bibliotecas.

Tabela 1 do 40 CFR 50, Apêndice N, §4.5, para série diária contínua.

Seleciona o ceil(n/50)-ésimo MAIOR dia válido, sem interpolação. Difere
de ceil(0,98*n) quando n é múltiplo de 50. Todos os dias válidos desta
série são creditáveis; não se aplica a calendário de amostragem distinto.
A extensão ao MP10 é comparativa, não uma regra legal desse poluente.

# Polygon path
def polygon_path(poly):
 def ring(coords):return 'M '+' L '.join(f'{x:.7f} {y:.7f}' for x,y in coords)+' z'
 return ' '.join(ring(v.coords) for v in [poly.exterior,*poly.interiors])

# Convert
def convert(source,target):
 d=E.parse(source);root=d.getroot();parents={x:p for p in root.iter() for x in p};count=0
 for p in list(root.iter()):
  if p.tag.rsplit('}',1)[-1]!='path':continue
  style=dict(v.strip().split(':',1) for v in (p.get('style') or '').split(';') if ':' in v);style={k:v.strip() for k,v in style.items()}
  color=style.get('stroke');width=float(style.get('stroke-width','1'))
  if not color or color=='none' or not (width<=.30 or color in ['#717d84','#b28d4f','#a54d40']):continue
  path=p.get('d','');commands=re.findall('[A-Za-z]',re.sub(r'[eE][+-]?\d+','',path))
  if set(commands)-set('MLZz'):continue
  paths=[]
  for part in re.split('[M]',path):
   if not part.strip():continue
   closed='z' in part.lower();values=[float(x) for x in re.findall(r'[-+]?(?:\d*\.\d+|\d+\.?\d*)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?',part)]
   if len(values)%2:raise ValueError('Coordenadas SVG inválidas')
   xy=list(zip(values[::2],values[1::2]))
   if len(xy)<2:continue
   if closed and xy[0]!=xy[-1]:xy.append(xy[0])
   poly=LineString(xy).buffer(width/2,cap_style='flat',join_style='round',quad_segs=3)
   for q in getattr(poly,'geoms',[poly]):
    if not q.is_empty:paths.append(polygon_path(q))
  if not paths:continue
  outline=deepcopy(p);outline.attrib.pop('id',None);outline.set('d',' '.join(paths));outline.set('style','fill: '+color+'; stroke: none'+('; fill-opacity: '+style['stroke-opacity'] if 'stroke-opacity' in style else ''))
  parent=parents[p];index=list(parent).index(p)
  if style.get('fill','black')!='none':
   style['stroke']='none';p.set('style','; '.join(k+': '+v for k,v in style.items()));parent.insert(index+1,outline)
  else:parent.remove(p);parent.insert(index,outline)
  count+=1
 if count:d.write(target,xml_declaration=True,encoding='utf-8')

# Run
def run():
 for prefix,uri in [('', 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'),('xlink','http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink'),('dc','http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/'),('cc','http://creativecommons.org/ns#'),('rdf','http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#')]:E.register_namespace(prefix,uri)
 OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);manifest=OUT/'manifesto.json';old=json.loads(manifest.read_text(encoding='utf8')) if manifest.exists() else {};records={}
 source_manifest=json.loads((R/'output/11_integracao/nova_modelagem/figuras_seminario_manifesto.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
 for item in source_manifest:
  if item['arquivo']=='ORIGINAL':continue
  source=Path(item['arquivo']).with_suffix('.svg');sha=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest();target=OUT/(source.stem+'_Word.svg');previous=old.get(str(source),{})
  if previous.get('version')==VERSION and previous.get('sha256')==sha and (not previous.get('converted') or Path(previous['output']).exists()):records[str(source)]=previous;continue
  count=convert(source,target);records[str(source)]={'source':str(source),'sha256':sha,'output':str(target) if count else str(source),'converted':count,'version':VERSION}
  print(source.name,count,'traços finos compatibilizados',flush=True)
 manifest.write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
 return records

    def zones(self,geoms):return gpd.GeoDataFrame(geometry=geoms,crs=31983)
    def test_area_and_volume(self):
        z=self.zones([box(0,0,25,10),box(25,0,100,10)])
        p,o,a,total=partition(box(0,0,100,10),z,'área horizontal')
        self.assertEqual(sorted(f for _,f,_ in p),[.25,.75]);self.assertEqual(o+a,0)
    def test_line_with_external_fraction(self):
        z=self.zones([box(0,0,25,10),box(25,0,50,10)])
        p,o,a,t=partition(LineString([(0,5),(100,5)]),z,'comprimento')
        self.assertEqual(sorted(f for _,f,_ in p),[.25,.25]);self.assertEqual(o,.5)
    def test_overlap_not_duplicated(self):
        z=self.zones([box(0,0,60,10),box(40,0,100,10)])
        p,o,a,t=partition(box(0,0,100,10),z,'área')
        self.assertAlmostEqual(sum(f for _,f,_ in p),.8);self.assertAlmostEqual(a,.2)
    def test_point_boundary_pending(self):
        z=self.zones([box(0,0,50,10),box(50,0,100,10)])
        self.assertEqual(partition(Point(50,5),z,'ponto')[:3],([],0.,1.))
    def test_line_on_shared_boundary(self):
        z=self.zones([box(0,0,50,10),box(50,0,100,10)])
        p,o,a,t=partition(LineString([(50,0),(50,10)]),z,'comprimento')
        self.assertEqual(p,[]);self.assertAlmostEqual(a,1);self.assertEqual(o,0)
    def test_oblique_line_closure_large_coordinates(self):
        z=self.zones([box(600000,7730000,600032.323,7730100),box(600032.323,7730000,600076.789,7730100)])
        p,o,a,t=partition(LineString([(600000.123,7730001.111),(600099.987,7730087.678)]),z,'comprimento')
        self.assertAlmostEqual(sum(f for _,f,_ in p)+o+a,1,places=12)
    def test_point_visual_polygon_is_not_footprint(self):
        s=pd.Series({'source_type':'POINT','geometry':box(0,0,10,10)})
        geom,basis=geometry_for_allocation(s,{'Num_Coords':1,'X1':5,'Y1':5})
        self.assertEqual(geom,Point(5,5));self.assertEqual(basis,'ponto')
    def test_volume_without_footprint_stays_pending(self):
        s=pd.Series({'source_type':'VOLUME','geometry':Point(5,5)})
        self.assertIsNone(geometry_for_allocation(s,{'Num_Coords':1,'X1':5,'Y1':5})[0])
    def test_total_of_two_groups_is_high(self):
        self.assertEqual(emission_class(60+60,5),'Alta (>100 t/ano)')
        self.assertEqual(emission_class(100,5),'Intermediária')
        self.assertEqual(emission_class(5,5),'Baixa / minoritária')

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()

from aermod_sources import _clean_geometry
from groups import infer_primary_group_from_source,canonical_group
from methodology_rules import group_mass_classes

# Inventorytests
class InventoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_mixed_geometry_preserves_area(self):
        poly=Polygon([(0,0),(2,0),(2,2),(0,2)])
        g=_clean_geometry(GeometryCollection([poly,LineString([(2,2),(3,3)])]))
        self.assertEqual(g.geom_type,'Polygon');self.assertEqual(g.area,4)

    def test_ids(self):
        for source,group in [('AEX01BCCA','CSN-CDP'),('VIA02CPI','CSN-PIR'),('CH01GER','GERDAU'),('VIA01VMF','VALE_FAB'),('VIA01VMV','VALE_VIG'),('AEX01FEP','FERRO'),('WG01','WGM')]:
            self.assertEqual(infer_primary_group_from_source(source),group)
        self.assertEqual(canonical_group('VALE S.A. - Mina de Fábrica'),'VALE_FAB')
        self.assertEqual(infer_primary_group_from_source('SCOF11','ÁREA CARREGAMENTO FERROVIÁRIO'),'SCOF')

    def test_annual_mass_not_annualized_twice(self):
        a=pd.DataFrame({'zone_index':[1,1,2,2,3], 'group_id':['a','a','a','b','a'],
            'emission_gs':[1.]*5,'emission_tpy':[60.,41.,60.,60.,100.]})
        m,g=group_mass_classes(a,[1,2,3],'PM10',annualization_basis='inventario_conciliado')
        self.assertTrue(m.loc[1,'emission_high']);self.assertTrue(m.loc[2,'emission_high'])
        self.assertFalse(m.loc[3,'emission_high']);self.assertEqual(m.loc[2,'emission_total_tpy'],120)

    def test_known_high_not_masked_by_unknown(self):
        a=pd.DataFrame({'zone_index':[1,1],'group_id':['a',None],
            'emission_gs':[1.,1.],'emission_tpy':[101.,10.]})
        m,g=group_mass_classes(a,[1],'PM10',annualization_basis='inventario_conciliado')
        self.assertTrue(m.loc[1,'emission_high']);self.assertEqual(m.loc[1,'emission_class'],'Majoritária')

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()

import unittest
import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point,box
from groups import canonical_post_group
from out_aermod_reader import link_receptors,saturation_class,filename_identity,PLT_GROUPS

# Tests
class Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_numeric_plt_mapping(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(PLT_GROUPS),29)
        self.assertEqual(filename_identity('24H1G028.PLT'),('SCOF','24H'))
        self.assertEqual(filename_identity('AN00G025.PLT'),('VALE_FAB','ANNUAL'))
        self.assertEqual(filename_identity('01HGALL.PLT'),('ALL','1H'))
        self.assertEqual(filename_identity('01_GURB-VIA.POS'),('URB-VIA','1H'))
    def test_exact_groups(self):
        for gid in ['URB','URB-FER','URB-NUC','URB-VIA','SCOF','COOPERA','VALE_FAB']:
            self.assertEqual(canonical_post_group('24_G'+gid),gid)
    def test_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(saturation_class(90),'Abaixo da faixa preventiva')
        self.assertEqual(saturation_class(100),'Próxima do padrão')
        self.assertEqual(saturation_class(100.001),'Acima do padrão')
        self.assertEqual(saturation_class(float('nan')),'Informação insuficiente')
    def test_recover_only_documented_rounding(self):
        z=gpd.GeoDataFrame({'zone_index':[0]},geometry=[box(0,0,1,1)],crs=31983)
        grid=gpd.GeoDataFrame(geometry=[Point(.004,.5)],crs=31983)
        coords=pd.DataFrame({'X':[0.,1.01],'Y':[.5,.5]})
        links,audit=link_receptors(coords,z,grid)
        self.assertEqual(len(links),1)
        self.assertEqual(audit['zones_strict_export'],0)
        self.assertEqual(audit['zones_original_precision'],1)

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
